sample_count_interpretation: 200 arms is a deliberately stricter frozen v2 choice, not an unambiguous restatement of the user minimum
python_cache_policy: __pycache__ is generated non-authoritative residue and is not deleted as history
frozen_g4_transport: one-shot-only; launch overhead is labeled and only common internal intervals decide overhead
g5_transport_requirement: one persistent child per same-G5 arm with immutable Store integrity mode
database_hash_semantics: post-row SQLite SHA-256 is physical-byte parity only and is not a logical database digest
